rules.text: Shared call mechanics and action permissions still apply when a number supplies business instructions.
rules.why: Agent instructions and the dialled number’s business profile are composed for the same call.

rules.text: A number’s Dynamic greeting is generated and may include a known caller’s name.
rules.instead: For a verbatim greeting use the agent’s fixed welcome_message. Use separate agents for different fixed greetings.

rules.text: Put common rules in the agent system_prompt and business details in the dialled number’s custom_prompt. The number profile takes precedence on conflicting business details. It cannot grant new permissions.

For a different greeting per business, keep Dynamic greeting on (the default) and put the opening line in that number’s custom_prompt. For example, “Start every call with: Thank you for calling Oak and Stone”.
Available inbound action forms depend on the agent’s enabled capabilities. Outbound menu controls do not apply.
Update a number profile, including its opening instruction, through the number settings endpoint.
On custom_prompt_too_long shorten the number profile. Use the agent’s knowledge for shared reference material.
